title: Primary culture of immature, naïve mouse CD4+ T cells
protocol: Euthanize P21 mice by CO2 inhalation.
Lay a mouse on its back on a dissection mat, pin the paws on the mat, and spray with 70% ethanol to wet the fur.
Make an incision in the peritoneum and cut the inferior vena cava to bleed the mouse to reduce red blood cells left in the spleen.
Gently lift the spleen using forceps and remove attached pancreatic tissue with scissors.
Transfer the spleen to a 15 mL collection tube containing 5 mL of T cell culture medium.
Pour the spleen with T cell culture medium into a 100 mm Petri dish.
Place a 70 μm cell strainer on top of a 50 mL conical tube and rinse the cell strainer with 1 mL ice cold 1×PBS (pH 7.4).
Smash the spleen on the cell strainer using a sterile plunger of a 1 mL syringe.
Flush the cell strainer with 10 mL ice cold 1×PBS (pH 7.4).
Discard the cell strainer and centrifuge the sample at 400 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by gently flipping the 50 mL tube.
Add 2 mL red blood cell lysis buffer to the tube and resuspend splenocytes by gentle pipetting.
Incubate for 3 min on ice.
Add 5 mL of T cell culture medium to stop the lysis of red blood cells.
Centrifuge the sample at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the splenocytes with 10 mL of ice cold pH 7.4 1×PBS.
Keep the cells on ice until finishing the cell counting.
Take out 20 μL of the cell suspension.
Dilute 10 times in 0.1% trypan blue.
Determine the splenocyte number with a hemocytometer.

Take 7 × 10^6 splenocytes prior to naïve CD4+ T cell purification for staining of the compensation control and for evaluating the percentage of naive CD4+ T cells before purification by flow cytometry.
Centrifuge the sample at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μL of purification buffer per 10⁸ total cells.
Add 100 μL of Biotin-Antibody Cocktail per 10⁸ total cells to the resuspended cell suspension.
Mix well and incubate for 5 min in the refrigerator (2–8°C).
Sterilize the mixture with a 0.22 μm filter and store at 4°C for up to 1 month.
Add 200 μL of purification buffer, 200 μL of Anti-Biotin MicroBeads, and 100 μL of CD44 MicroBeads per 10⁸ total cells in sequence.
Mix them well and incubate for 10 min in the refrigerator (2–8°C).
Place a LS column in the magnetic field of MidiMACS Separator.
Prepare the LS column by rinsing with 3 mL of purification buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto the column and collect the flow-through that contain unlabeled cells enriched in naïve CD4+ T cells.
Wash the column with 3 mL of purification buffer.
Collect unlabeled cells in the flow-through and combine with the flow-through from step 18.
Determine the cell number with a hemocytometer.
Take 1 × 10⁶ cells for staining to evaluate the purity of naïve CD4+ T cells by flow cytometry.
Take 1 × 10^6 splenocytes and fix them with 4% PFA for 10 min on ice to generate a positive control for dead cell staining.
Wash the fixed cells twice by adding 300 μl of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C to collect the cell pellet.
Store the collected cells at 4°C for up to 1 month.
Mix fixed cells with 1 × 10^6 unfixed splenocytes to create a single-stained cell compensation control for Fixable Viability Dye.
Transfer 1 × 10^6 unfixed cells to each well of a 96-well round bottom plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Dilute 1 μL of concentrated Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 stock with 2 mL of 1×PBS (pH 7.4) to prepare the staining solution.
Resuspend the compensation control cell pellet in one well with 100 μL of diluted Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780.
Incubate the cells for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Prepare multiple staining antibody solutions and single-staining solutions as specified.
Resuspend the cell pellets in other wells with 200 μL of 1×PBS (pH 7.4).
Centrifuge the plate again at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Wash the cell pellet twice using 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the two wells for multiple staining with 100 μL of antibody mix 1 solution.
Resuspend the cell pellets in other wells for single staining with 100 μL of respective single staining solution.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the well for Fixable Viability Dye staining with 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Incubate the samples for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells twice by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Passage the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer on top of a 5 mL Falcon® tube.
Analyze the samples with Fortessa 405/488/561/640 (BD Biosciences) flow cytometer.
Centrifuge the purified naïve CD4+ T cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant completely.
Wash the αCD3 pre-coated, 48-well tissue culture plate with 1 mL of 1× PBS (pH 7.4).
Resuspend the cell pellet in T cell culture medium and adjust the cell density to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Seed 5 × 10^5 cells in 0.5 mL of cell suspension in each well of the 48-well tissue culture plate.
Add respective antibodies, chemicals, and recombinant proteins for Th0, Th1, Th2, and Th17 cultures according to specific instructions.
Prepare immediately before use and add reagents individually to the culture medium.
Use human IL-2 to stimulate proliferation of mouse T cells.
Alternatively, use mouse IL-2 at the same concentration as human IL-2.
Prepare IL-2 immediately before use and add it individually to the culture medium.
Add IL-23 to each well after 2 days of initial culturing.
Culture the plate in a CO2 incubator for 4 days at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Mix anti-mIL-4 antibody (10 μg/mL) to Th1 culture.
Mix anti-mIFN-γ antibody (10 μg/mL) to Th2 culture.
Mix anti-mIL-4 antibody (10 μg/mL) and anti-mIFN-γ antibody (10 μg/mL) to Th17 culture at the beginning of each culture.
Determine the cell number at the end of T-cell culture.
Collect cells (no more than 5 × 10^6 cells) in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube by spinning for 5 min at 400 × g.
Carefully discard all the supernatant.
Pause point: Proceed with RNA extraction following manufacturer’s protocol or snap freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen before storage at −80°C.
Flick the tube to thoroughly loosen the cell pellet.
Add 350 μL Buffer RLT to the tube and mix well by pipetting.
Transfer the lysate into a QIAshredder spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 8000 × g.
Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the homogenized lysate and mix well by pipetting.
Transfer up to 700 μL of the sample to an RNeasy spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 8000 × g.
Discard the flow-through.
Add 700 μL Buffer RW1 to the column and centrifuge for 15 s at 8000 × g.
Discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge for 15 s at 8000 × g.
Discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL Buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge for 2 min at 8000 × g.
Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 8000 × g for 1 min.
Place the RNeasy spin column into a new 1.5 mL collection tube.
Add 30 μL RNase-free water to the spin column membrane.
Centrifuge the spin column for 1 minute at 8000 × g to elute RNA.
Determine the RNA concentration of each sample using a NanoDrop™ 2000 spectrophotometer.
Prepare the mix according to Table 9 specifications for step 1.
Heat the mixture to 65°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate the heated mixture on ice for at least 1 minute.
Collect the contents of the tubes by brief centrifugation.
Add cDNA mix 2 to the collected tube content.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the mix at 50°C for 50 minutes.
Heat inactivate the reaction at 85°C for 5 minutes.
Hold the inactivated mixture at 4°C.
Dilute cDNA template to 10 ng/μL with distilled water.
Mix TaqMan® PCR Master Mix with different TaqMan® primers.
Transfer the mixed reagents to a 96 well Unskirted qPCR Plate.
Add diluted cDNA templates to respective wells in the plate.
Cover the qPCR plate with optical flat 8-cap strips.
Centrifuge the covered qPCR plate at 600 × g for 1 min.
Put the cultures back to CO2 incubator.
Incubate for 4 h.
Collect the cells by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Transfer resuspended cells to each allocated well of a 96-well round bottom plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Prepare Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 staining solution by diluting 1 μL of original solution with 2 mL of 1×PBS (pH 7.4).
Resuspend the cell pellet with 100 μL of diluted Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Surface marker staining should be performed here with Live/Dead cell staining before fixation.
Wash twice by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL Fixation/permeabilization solution per 1 million cells.
Mix well to dissociate the cell pellet and prevent cross-linking of individual cells.
Fix for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash twice by adding 300 μL of 1× Perm/Wash solution, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the well for multiple staining with 100 μL of antibody mix solution.
Resuspend the cell pellets in the wells for single staining with 100 μL of respective single staining solution.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the well for no staining and Fixable Viability Dye staining with 100 μL of 1× Perm/Wash solution.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash twice by adding 300 μL of 1× Perm/Wash solution, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Passage the cell suspension through the 40 μm cell strainer on top of the 5 mL Falcon® tube before analysis with Fortessa 405/488/561/640 (BD Biosciences) flow cytometer.
Take 1 × 10^6 cells and fix them with 4% PFA for 10 min on ice.
Wash fixed cells twice by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C, and discard the supernatant.
Mix fixed cells with 1 × 10^6 unfixed cells as a single-stained cell compensation control.
Transfer 1 × 10^6 cells to each labeled 1.5 mL centrifuge tube and centrifuge the sample at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Dilute 1 μL of original Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 solution with 2 mL of 1×PBS (pH 7.4).
Resuspend cell pellet in the tube for multiple staining and single-staining compensation control for the Fixable Viability Dye with 100 μL of diluted Live/Dead Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780.
Incubate cells resuspended in 1×PBS (pH 7.4) for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash stained cells twice by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C, and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of 4% formaldehyde per 1 million cells.
Mix well to dissociate the cell pellet and prevent cross-linking of individual cells.
Fix for 30 min at 4°C.
Permeabilize cells by slowly adding ice-cold 100% methanol to pre-chilled cells while gently vortexing to a final concentration of 90% methanol.
Permeabilize for 45 min on ice.
Wash cells twice with 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the well for multiple staining with 100 μL of antibody mix solution.
Resuspend the cell pellets in the wells for single staining with 100 μL of respective single staining solution.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the well for no staining and Fixable Viability Dye staining with 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Wash twice by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Passage the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer on top of a 5 mL Falcon® tube before analysis with Fortessa 405/488/561/640 (BD Biosciences) flow cytometer.
